in_sanskrit.name: Bahuleya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Blessed with many virtues
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bahuleya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Bahuleya is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a combination of the words 'Bahu' meaning many and 'Ile' or 'Aya' meaning virtues. This name signifies a person who is blessed with numerous virtues and is highly regarded in society.
